types.name: role
types.description: The role assigned to a person. Every person has exactly one role.

values.description: A person who is an enrolled student.
A person who is a member of staff.
A person who is a visitor.
A role that is not one of the modeled roles (enrolled student, staff, or visitor).

types.name: safetyTraining
types.description: The status of a person's safety training. It is either current or not current. Training that has expired or was never completed is not current.

values.description: The person's safety training is current.
The person's safety training is not current, including training that has expired or was never completed.
A safety training status that is not one of the modeled states (current or not current).

rules.alternateExpression: A person's role must be one of the modeled roles: enrolled student, staff, or visitor (it cannot be the OTHER value).
A person's safety training status must be one of the modeled states: current or not current (it cannot be the OTHER value).
Visitors cannot check out lab equipment, regardless of their safety training.
A person whose safety training is not current cannot check out lab equipment, regardless of their role.
if isCheckoutAllowed is true, then personRole is equal to enrolled student or personRole is equal to staff
if isCheckoutAllowed is true, then personSafetyTraining is equal to current
if isCheckoutAllowed is false, then personSafetyTraining is not equal to current or personRole is not equal to enrolled student
if isCheckoutAllowed is false, then personSafetyTraining is not equal to current or personRole is not equal to staff

variables.name: personRole
variables.description: The role assigned to a person: enrolled student, staff, or visitor.

variables.name: personSafetyTraining
variables.description: The status of a person's safety training: current or not current.

variables.name: isCheckoutAllowed
variables.description: Whether the person may check out lab equipment. True if and only if the person is permitted to check out lab equipment.
